headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Overweight on Corpay, Raises Price Target to $415

headline: Paypal (PYPL) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
summary: Paypal (PYPL) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +7.81% and +2.02%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
